title: Finite pointed etale neighbourhoods are refined by split pieces
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], Omega an algebraically closed field, y:Spec Omega\to Y and t:Spec Omega\to X with t followed by f equal to y. For each pointed etale neighbourhood d of t [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods], there is a pointed etale neighbourhood c of y with a decomposition of c times_Y X [def-pc-fibre-product] into clopen pieces indexed by the geometric fibre, each containing its corresponding geometric point, such that the t-piece has a morphism to d preserving the marked point.

source.place: Proof, integral algebra over the strict henselisation and conservativity

proof.text: Use the existing full proof in PieceSection.lean:53-173: choose an affine chart and orthogonal idempotents of the finite algebra after a pointed etale extension; shrink d around its point to an affine etale algebra; the pointed etale tensor section theorem gives a further etale extension and section. The spectrum of the section maps the selected split piece to d. The tensor point equation proves marked-point preservation.
